location_exception_reason: Prefabricated walls are manufactured components with standardised specifications (core material, thickness, fire rating, load capacity) that are location-agnostic. Buyer decisions are driven by technical performance and material type, not origin geography. Regional origin is not a genuine product differentiator.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Distributor, Dealer) in titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title like 'PUF Panel Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning complete and unchanged; the product is a PUF panel regardless of seller classification.
